- Operational: Retention controls configurable per-customer, per-route observability (token-level latency and cost), SOC 2 Type II with latest report date 2028-04-30 (cover page available on request), and audit logs accessible for eDiscovery under commercial agreements.

DPF alignment note: We describe our controls against DPF-style criteria (contractual assurances, encryption/key controls, subprocessor minimization, and demonstrable audit logs).
